{{Orphan|date=February 2017}}

In [[topology]] and related areas of [[mathematics]], a [[topological space]] <math>X</math> is a '''nodec space''' if every [[nowhere dense]] [[subset]] of <math>X</math> is [[Closed set|closed]]. This concept was introduced and studied by {{harvtxt|van Douwen|1993}}.
